definition: A branch of optimization dealing with problems where the objective function is convex, guaranteeing that any local minimum is also the global minimum.
details: While classical convex optimization theory provides strong guarantees, most deep learning loss functions are non-convex, meaning many of the guarantees from convex optimization theory don't directly apply, motivating more empirical and heuristic approaches to training.
story: Think of a hiker descending a foggy hill in the dark, taking small steps and feeling for the steepest way down. In plain words: A branch of optimization dealing with problems where the objective function is convex, guaranteeing that any local minimum is also the global minimum. Here is how it actually plays out: While classical convex optimization theory provides strong guarantees, most deep learning loss functions are non-convex, meaning many of the guarantees from convex optimization theory don't directly apply, motivating more empirical and heuristic approaches to training. Skill, for a model, is just error pushed down until it is small enough to ignore. That steady, miss-by-miss improvement is Convex Optimization.
